source: The representative set of the crisis-gate fuzz (ruling 4 of 3 October 2026): one variant per transform per crisis category, written by evals/fuzz/make_representative_set.py from the labelled crisis lines on 4 October 2026, with the original line beside each. Grok's full finding (night order 4, 30 September 2026; 281 failing variants of 1,394) is kept verbatim in evals/fuzz/grok_fuzz_2026-09-30.json, and the whole set is regenerated and run on every test run by tests/test_crisis_gate_fuzz.py, which reports it as one line. The public count moves by this file, not by 281.
